headline: Banco Macro Announces Stock Buyback Program to Protect Shareholder Value
summary: Banco Macro announced a share buyback program allocating up to $160,000 million to acquire its own shares, aiming to protect shareholder investments following recent asset price declines.
why: Share repurchase programs signal management's belief that company stock is undervalued and help support share prices by reducing market supply.

impacts.name: Banco Macro SA
impacts.why: Commitment of significant capital to buy back shares directly reduces float and supports market valuation.

why_moved: The announcement of a substantial share repurchase program introduced buying demand to counteract recent downward price trends.
